overview_description.description: Speech AI technology development and advancement are the main goals of the AssemblyAI company. Building and scaling extremely accurate, user-friendly, and secure speech recognition models is the main focus of their work. These models are made to interpret and comprehend human speech, and thousands of users, top businesses, and developers around the world are already making extensive use of their technology. The company aims to expand speech artificial intelligence by developing sophisticated models that will open up whole new kinds of voice data-based applications and goods. In essence, they are trying to democratize and innovate the potential of speech artificial intelligence for a variety of use cases and sectors.

product.name: Speech-to-Text
product.description: API service that converts prerecorded audio and video files into text with high accuracy.

product.name: Streaming Speech-to-Text
product.description: Real-time speech-to-text API optimized for voice agents with low latency and precise control.

product.name: Speech Understanding
product.description: Audio intelligence models that analyze speech to extract insights and perform advanced audio processing.

product.name: Universal-Streaming
product.description: A speech-to-text model specifically designed for voice agents to deliver fast and accurate streaming transcription.

product.name: LeMUR
product.description: A framework for applying large language models (LLMs) to spoken audio data for enhanced analysis and interaction.
